dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: Nothing here yet. Modules add their admin pages and widgets automatically.

permissions.accessDescription: Open the pages under the admin area. The data behind them checks its own permissions.
permissions.reindexDescription: Recompute the search columns of every table that has them.

searchIndex.title: Search
searchIndex.description: Rebuild the search columns after an update.
searchIndex.hint: Run it once after a deploy whose notes ask for it, or when a search for a name with æ, ø or å misses records. It changes no data, only the columns search reads.

confirm.title: Rebuild search?
confirm.description: Every row of the searchable tables is read again, and its search columns are rewritten where they differ. On large tables it takes a while; search keeps working meanwhile.
